upstream_implementation: No MIT-LCP/mimic-code SAPS III concept exists in release v3.0.1. Version 2 is a project-owned proxy sensitivity calculation; unavailable original variables remain null and published equations are exported only with explicit proxy/unvalidated names.

v2_interpretation_policy.wbc_extremum: highest, following the original 2005 data-definition supplement; the later one-page score sheet has a conflicting lowest label
v2_interpretation_policy.ph_specimen: arterial or venous, as explicitly permitted by the original supplement
v2_interpretation_policy.temperature: central site used directly; documented peripheral site adjusted by +0.5 C; unknown site unavailable
v2_interpretation_policy.unrecoverable_original_variables: null in original component fields; versioned proxy fields are retained only for sensitivity analysis
v2_interpretation_policy.probability_status: published equation transcription applied only to an explicitly named unvalidated proxy total
